sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
l'audit riguarda il fornitore, non le singole parti.

findings.why: The ASL is the complete controlled list for TO1/STL. Meccanica C is not listed for BR-220. Its approvals cover only BR-180 (TO1, STL) and BR-310 (TO2, CLM). Lifting the probation and passing the audit do not grant a part approval.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 is in program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL CSR. Moving the billet source from Alluminio B to Meccanica C is a material source change. It needs written Stellantis approval before shipment, and no such approval is in the documents.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
Root cause not confirmed. A material-related contribution has not been excluded.
Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).

findings.why: Meccanica C has an OPEN 8D on cracks at fastener holes in 6xxx alloy brackets, and a material contribution is not excluded. BR-220 is also a 6xxx alloy part with 4 fastener holes. The probation lift does not close the 8D, as the 2026-11-05 email itself says.

sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01
Rev B is superseded and withdrawn as of 2026-06-01.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The drawing in force (Rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 of at least 250 MPa (SC-01). The email relies on the superseded Rev B (6061-T6, 240 MPa). Meccanica C is approved only for 6061-T6 billet, so the offered material does not meet the drawing in force.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat

findings.why: There is no EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result for any Meccanica C billet lot. Grade, temper and Rp0.2 against SC-01 cannot be confirmed. A person must obtain and answer this.
